name: scraper
description: - **Target Site:** Books to Scrape (https://books.toscrape.com) - **Purpose:** Public practice sandbox designed explicitly for web scraping practice. - **Scope:** First 3 catalogue pages (~60 book detail pages). - **Data Collected:** Title, product URL, price, availability, rating, description, source page, and fetch timestamp. - **Robots.txt Check:** Requested `https://books.toscrape.com/robots.txt` (result: no robots file found). - **Ethics Statement:** I will not reuse this code on another site without checking its rules and terms first.
